text: undertone: new repo ~/Documents/GitHub/undertone (private, github.com/coterboat/undertone), v0 commit 8cefeab. A sibling mod to coter-kit: Tone.js page (web/index.html) + zero-dep bridge on 127.0.0.1:4747 (bridge/server.mjs) + hooks mod (hooks/register.js) that turns session events into music; 9 tests pass via `claude plugin test .`
Listen to undertone v0 and say whether the vibe is right (mix was balanced by meter only; Claude can't hear it)

undertone next: confirm it sees coter-kit's checklist/remember calls (depends on plugin order), then decide whether to list it in coter-kit's marketplace and whether the bridge should outlive sessions

User listened to undertone v0: loves it, sees it as Claude communicating what needs their attention through sound; asked for less crackle, picking projects, real waiting count, coter-kit marketplace listing, and swappable free engines (Synth, Sampled, Strudel, SuperCollider) to judge
undertone vision (user's words): 'this can basically become you as a system communicating to me what's going on / what needs my attention through sound and song'

undertone v1 pushed (d948567): four swappable engines (Synth, Sampled/smplr, Strudel, SuperCollider), per-session calls for 'your move' and 'needs your OK', Projects panel with lead project, heartbeat, real waiting count from the brain. Listed in coter-kit's marketplace (49f0a08). Next: the user judges the engines; persistent bridge (detached plus idle exit) proposed, not built
undertone's SuperCollider must boot with an output-only device as the input too: started from a Claude Code child process, scsynth hangs on the macOS microphone check (TCC charges it to Claude Code)
Judge undertone's four engines by ear (Synth, Sampled, Strudel, SuperCollider) and say which vibe and quality wins

undertone ears shipped (69319af): Love this / This grates / Snapshot save clips + spectrogram + stats under ~/.undertone/ear; Claude reads the PNGs. Gemini critique waits on the user's API key (~/.config/undertone/gemini.key). Open findings: Synth mix is dark (almost nothing above 2.5 kHz), clicks near bar starts (suspect bass retrigger), SuperCollider's bass sub-octave makes it sub-heavy
Guardrails (blocking hooks) wait until undertone has run longer; phone notifications, metrics/timesheets from ~/.undertone/log, and non-Claude event sources are wanted next

undertone Gemini critic works with the user's key (~/.config/undertone/gemini.key, newer 53-char format); gemini-flash-latest often 503s, so the critic retries and falls back; it listens blind (no stats), because with stats it parroted them

undertone Synth engine, agreed by spectrogram + two Gemini reads: drums buried (no snap), mud at 180-300 Hz, instruments filtered dark while tape hiss sits alone on top (fatiguing). Next: tuning loop with before/after spectrograms, if the user wants it

ourPlace has a no-content workspace telemetry stream (Ourplace.client/src/Components/OurPlacesV2/Workspace/telemetry.js) built to deliver to window.appInsights, but Application Insights isn't wired on the site or the API, so production telemetry goes nowhere today

undertone ourPlace prod source: built (sources/azure-metrics.mjs, Azure Monitor counts only, mock works). Waiting on the user to run `az login`; then discover resources (OpenAI account, App Service, Search) and fill ~/.config/undertone/sources.json. Real per-interaction events would need App Insights wired on the site (their call, a client prod change)
undertone phone pings go to ntfy topic in ~/.config/undertone/ntfy.json (user's phone is Android); the Grok bot is the Grok app synced to GitHub, not a chat bot
